user.title: Log in to ICA
user.description: Log in with the personnummer and password you use in the ICA app. BankID-only accounts are not supported – set a password at ica.se first. Home Assistant must run on a Swedish IP address.

list.title: Choose list
list.description: Pick the ICA list to sync and the Home Assistant to-do list to sync it with.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to ICA again
reauth_confirm.description: ICA rejected the stored login. Enter your personnummer and password again.

reauth_list.title: Choose list
reauth_list.description: The previously configured list could not be found on this account. Pick the list to sync.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong personnummer or password (or the account only supports BankID).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ICA. Try again later.
error.geo_blocked: ICA blocks requests from outside Sweden (HTTP 451). Home Assistant must run on a Swedish IP address.
error.no_lists: The account has no shopping lists. Create one in the ICA app first.

init.title: ICA Shopping Configuration
init.description: Changing the list may sync existing to-do items to the new ICA list. Check the list first if needed.
